_comment: Branch-protection payload for the FUL repo default branch. Origin: FUL-23 task 1; merge-policy resolved in FUL-34; interim count=0 ratified in FUL-35; IaC reconciled to live in FUL-36; count RESTORED to 1 in FUL-37 now that a second approving identity exists. Apply with ops/apply-branch-protection.sh (token needs repo-admin). NOTES: (1) required_status_checks.contexts must be the CHECK-RUN/job name 'baileys-sidecar-gate' alone, NOT 'baileys-sidecar-ci / baileys-sidecar-gate' (the 'workflow / job' form is unsatisfiable and made main permanently unmergeable). (2) required_approving_review_count is 1: the dedicated 'ffr-merge-reviewer' GitHub App (see ops/PROVISION-REVIEWER.md) is a second principal distinct from the PR author darshjme, so a non-self approval is always available — this does NOT re-create the FUL-34 deadlock. The App auto-approves only ROUTINE PRs on a green baileys-sidecar-gate; it never approves PRs touching CODEOWNERS-protected paths. (3) With count>=1, require_code_owner_reviews is now ENFORCED: changes to CODEOWNERS-owned paths require a human Security (code-owner) review — the bot cannot satisfy it because it is not a CODEOWNER. Rollback to count=0 (FUL-35 posture) only if the App is ever uninstalled, to avoid an unmergeable main.
